title: CROA Governed Action Request (gar.*)
description: Structured input submitted by a governed agent to the Agent Surface. Normative source: CROA Specification v1.0.1, Part II §4.5.1. The prose schema is authoritative; this file is companion material (Appendix B).

gar.request_id.description: Unique identifier generated by the governed agent; correlates the request with subsequent C5 events.

gar.type.description: Typed action class (e.g., code.write, api.invoke, data.read, config.change). Valid set defined in the applicable C1 policy artifact.

gar.target.description: Identifier of the governed external system or resource the action is directed at.

gar.parameters.description: Action-type-specific parameters, structured per the C1 policy artifact schema for gar.type.

gar.context_refs.description: Entities/APIs/services/data stores/dependencies the action references; C3 MUST resolve each against the Federated Context Registry before forwarding to C2.

$comment: The agent MUST NOT include stated reasoning, urgency assertions or compliance self-reports (§4.5.1). The Agent Surface MUST reject any request carrying fields outside this schema, recording ADMISSION_REJECTED with event.rejection_reason = SCHEMA_VIOLATION. Admission additionally requires the subject authorization model (§4.9.1) and, where the Agent Qualification Layer is deployed, the qualification gate (§4.9.2); neither is expressible in this schema.
